title: NAF 22736 — Duquesne, ff137r–138r and144v
contents: Duquesne discusses negotiations with the Tripolins, the return of enslaved French subjects and captured ships, vessels suitable for use as fire-ships, treaty provisions and naval affairs. The later letter states the obligation to retain the position until express orders arrive and the hope of ending the campaign advantageously.
fields: 25 September 1681; later letter in the same September correspondence
Interlinear plaintext on the cipher pages.

excerpt: **…muler nous sommes obligez de ne pas abandonner ce poste ni ces lieux sans les ordres expres**
translation: …we are obliged not to abandon this post or these places without express orders.
